top_signals.title: Bitcoin nears 3-week low as oil heads higher on Iran strike woes
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000 and oil prices gained after reports that military confrontation between the US and Iran could return.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: True Religion CEO on Company Transformation and Gen Z Customers
top_signals.summary: True Religion CEO Michael Buckley discusses the brands comeback, noting its origins as a premium women’s denim brand in the early 2000s and its recent pivot toward more affordable offerings. Gen Z interest and attention from celebrities have helped revive the brand. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
